statement: The plugin's own per-entry-point counters and the fabric (slot,seq,consumed_seq) witness are the evidence for the observed value; the model value comes from epic_cluster.link_model's public per_link_bytes. This file is the human-reviewed acknowledgement required by acceptance 2c; the scenario script asserts against it and fails if it is absent or if the ratio disagrees with the run.
